title: Pokecade
description: PokeCade is a Cobblemon server where you can meet new friends, explore exciting worlds, and catch amazing Pokémon together!
body:
Pokecade is a brand new Cobblemon server packed with exciting features and a welcoming, competitive community! 🌟 Jump in to explore a fresh Cobblemon experience, take part in epic tournaments, and connect with other trainers.
